% Broadband driver — longitudinal

\delta v_{\parallel,\odot}(t) = A_\parallel\,\sum_{N=0}^{N_{\max}}\frac{\sin(2\pi f_N^\parallel t + \varphi_N^\parallel)}{\sqrt{f_N^\parallel}}

% Power spectrum
\begin{equation}\label{eq:E1_spectrum}
P(\omega) = A^2/\omega,\qquad \int_{\omega_\mathrm{min}}^{\omega_\mathrm{max}} P(\omega)\,\mathrm{d}\omega = A^2\,\ln(\omega_\mathrm{max}/\omega_\mathrm{min})

% Normalisation to target rms
\begin{equation}\label{eq:E1_norm}

% Parseval / Koopman variance (random phases)

% Log-spaced sampling to mimic $\omega^{-1}$
\begin{equation}\label{eq:E1_logspace}
f_N = f_\mathrm{min}\,\bigl(f_\mathrm{max}/f_\mathrm{min}\bigr)^{N/N_{\max}},\quad f_\mathrm{max} = 100\,f_\mathrm{min}

% Incoming-Alfvén absorbing BC
\begin{equation}\label{eq:E1_BC}
